settings.title: Shipping
settings.content_intl:
Orders placed before 4pm dispatch from Brisbane the same afternoon.

  • Singapore: 4 to 6 days. Free standard shipping over S$250.
  • United Kingdom: 5 to 8 days. Free standard shipping over £65.
  • Europe: 6 to 9 days.

Every international order ships DDP. Duties and import taxes are calculated and paid at checkout, so nothing is owed on arrival.
